//: CCT-scoped type-check config for the Pi enforcement runtime (T6.5, FR-016). `tsc --noEmit -p` here is the type-check verification gate. `module`/`moduleResolution: nodenext` (with the sibling package.json `type: module`) makes tsc model `node --experimental-strip-types` resolution exactly — relative imports must carry an extension — so the gate cannot pass code the runtime would fail to load with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND (bundler resolution silently allowed extensionless imports; that parity hole is closed). `allowImportingTsExtensions` keeps the runtime's `.ts` imports legal; checked but never emitted. `strict` is the enforced baseline (catches the T1.5-class null/undefined defects strip-types silently ships). `noUncheckedIndexedAccess` is a deferred tightening: it currently flags ~28 safe-in-practice index-access sites whose mass rewrite is out of T6.5's scope; enable it once those are hardened.
